title: Incentives for Shopping Malls to Install Tactile Paving to Aid Visually Impaired
what_it_is: Incentives for Shopping Malls to Install Tactile Paving to Aid Visually Impaired

sections.label: BCA Accessibility Fund co-funding
sections.summary: The BCA Accessibility Fund co-funds eligible building owners to add accessibility features, including tactile paving and signage, up to 60% of construction cost capped at $300,000 per development.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Speaker, BCA’s Accessibility Fund (AF) provides co-funding for eligible building owners to upgrade their buildings with accessibility features.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: These features would also include aid for the visually impaired, such as tactile paving and information signage.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: For eligible private buildings, including shopping malls, the AF co-funds up to 60% of the construction cost for such features, capped at $300,000 per development.

sections.label: New buildings and older buildings
sections.summary: New buildings have accessibility features under building codes, while the Accessibility Fund encourages older buildings to adopt them.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Today, under our building accessibility codes, the new buildings will certainly have such accessibility features on board.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: The AF is to encourage older buildings to come on board.

sections.label: Encouraging A&A accessibility upgrades
sections.summary: BCA encourages accessibility features during A&A, but enforcing it on all buildings is difficult as many were not purpose-built for such features.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: When they undergo A&A, BCA will try to encourage as much as we can.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: But to enforce it on all buildings is quite difficult because many of these buildings may or may not necessarily have the design features or they were not purpose-built for these.

sections.label: Orchard Road barrier-free accessibility
sections.summary: Over 90% of existing buildings in the Orchard Road shopping belt have achieved barrier-free accessibility, and more can be done, especially in the heartlands.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: To give an example, more than 90% of existing buildings in the Orchard Road shopping belt have already achieved barrier-free accessibility.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Certainly, we can do more, and in the heartlands, especially, and see how we can make it better.
